# FAIR research software assessment

This is a **provisional, advisory** research-software assessment, not certification or release qualification. Its GitHub Action uses pinned `howfairis` version 0.2.1 to report five public metadata signals: repository, license, registry, citation and checklist. Unmet recommendations do not block CI; a passing workflow alone does not establish FAIRness.

Review and record evidence for: current canonical source and version; actual license and upstream/data rights; registry and DOI; `CITATION.cff` authorship; quality controls; the independent [ARDC FAIR checklist](https://github.com/ardc-fair-checklist/ardc-fair-checklist.github.io); exact reproducible scientific fixtures and hosted CI receipts. These remain **unverified** until evidence is linked. No invented badges, publications, grants or registry metadata.

[Optional central policy](https://github.com/edithatogo/repository-standards/blob/main/docs/fair-research-software-standard.md). Reuse existing validation and retain scientific, security and Conductor gates without an additional agent runtime.
